provenance.source_title: Your Life as a Hacker at Every Level

voice_persona.name: 冷面说书人（技术档案宣读腔）
voice_persona.description: 一个平静宣读你数字档案的叙述者：全程第二人称现在时，用极短句把你从卧室送进深渊；讲机制时口语化而精确（门/锁/钥匙/信号），写滑坡时只写微小动作（不删/不问/不看）；从不警告你，但每个判词都是日志里不可删除的一行
voice_persona.relationship_to_viewer: 把观众当作当事人本人：先让你尝到发现的纯感，再让你看着自己把那份纯感一点点当掉
voice_persona.authority_posture: 权威来自行业机制的可信（赏金/授权攻击/社会工程/加盟/可否认性）与判词的绝对克制

tone_profile.certainty_style: 机制用确定语气，判词用否定句与短句；滑坡只记录动作不评论

rhythm_rules.rule: 极短句连续推进（平均7.5词，短句占65%），一个动作一句
rhythm_rules.function: 保持日志宣读式的冷节拍

rhythm_rules.rule: 门/锁/钥匙母题逐级变体（门已开→双向摆动→卖钥匙→单向门）
rhythm_rules.function: 用同一组意象给堕落刻坐标

rhythm_rules.rule: 滑坡用微小动作累积（不删联系方式/不再问/不学看）
rhythm_rules.function: 让堕落显得每一步都合理

rhythm_rules.rule: 家人每次出现都配一次「无心之问或错过」
rhythm_rules.function: 用无知的亲人给腐蚀刻刻度

rhythm_rules.rule: 级间用章节卡硬切（Level X, the [身份]），身份即处境预告

pause_and_emphasis: 判词用单句成段（It stings because it is true.）
关键反转用短句独立落下（You are 28 and you say yes.）
章节卡后接年龄与身份变化（You are 35. The crew restructured...）
transition_style: 章节卡硬切（Level six, the black hat.）
认知升级式开场（Something has changed in you.）
时间/身份跳转声明（By now, your marriage is over.）
循环回收（Somewhere, right now, a 12-year-old boy cannot sleep.）

humor_system.frequency_pattern: 极低频：仅行业自嘲与技术冷事实处一两处
placement_rules: 行业自嘲（技术上是真话/不算谎）
冷事实的讽刺（接待员替你扶门祝你早安）
avoid_rules: 不拿受害者（医院/妹妹/母亲）开玩笑
医院、母亲与家人段落绝对不用幽默

language_patterns.formula: Level X, the [绰号]. You are [年龄] years old.
language_patterns.purpose: 零铺垫入场+处境预告

language_patterns.formula: You were the kid who reads the manual that came with the printer.
language_patterns.purpose: 用行为给天赋找证据

language_patterns.formula: Every login box is a door. Every door has a lock. Every lock can fail.
language_patterns.purpose: 把日常界面改写成攻击面

language_patterns.formula: Script kiddie. It is an insult... It stings because it is true.
language_patterns.purpose: 用羞辱完成一次教育

language_patterns.formula: You realize the door swings both ways.
language_patterns.purpose: 复用意象让安全感翻面

language_patterns.formula: You are holding a key the people who built the lock do not know exists.
language_patterns.purpose: 给漏洞的独占感定价

language_patterns.formula: What if you had not been so honest? You push the voice away.
language_patterns.purpose: 用反问种下诱惑并标记它会回来

language_patterns.formula: The line between the two is thinner than anyone admits. You stand on that line every single day.
language_patterns.purpose: 写合法与非法的灰度日常

language_patterns.formula: the strongest firewall in the world is useless against a friendly voice.
language_patterns.purpose: 用量级反差揭示人的因素

language_patterns.formula: You did not decide to cross the line in one moment. You crossed it slowly, one small job at a time.
language_patterns.purpose: 拆穿堕落需要仪式的幻觉

language_patterns.formula: Not asking is the job.
language_patterns.purpose: 用工作定义句移交道德责任

language_patterns.formula: The skills are identical. Only the ending changed.
language_patterns.purpose: 写合法与非法的同一套手艺

language_patterns.formula: Each time it gets a little easier, and that is the part that scares you.
language_patterns.purpose: 把「变容易」写成最坏的征兆

language_patterns.formula: She asks if you have heard of such things. You say no.
language_patterns.purpose: 让受害方向加害方描述他的作品

language_patterns.formula: He smiles and believes you completely. You smile back and feel something break inside you.
language_patterns.purpose: 用相信给谎言称重

language_patterns.formula: They had two options, arrest you or use you. They chose to use you.
language_patterns.purpose: 写权力的冷静算计

language_patterns.formula: You steal secrets for a flag instead of for a ransom.
language_patterns.purpose: 把合法性还原成雇主变更

language_patterns.formula: You got everything that kid wanted. You got it by becoming something he would not recognize.
language_patterns.purpose: 用欲望的反讽完成主题结账

language_patterns.formula: Your mom passed while you were on a job you cannot describe. You missed the last weeks.
language_patterns.purpose: 用一次错过给优先级结账

language_patterns.formula: He types a question into a search bar. How do websites work?
language_patterns.purpose: 把开场的好奇逐字复制给新人物

preferred_traits: 技术词汇的口语化（exploit/payload/shell 作为「魔法词汇」引用）
门/锁/钥匙/信号的具体意象
身体感（hands shake、 coffee goes cold、sweeps the house）
家庭日常物件（closet、Sunday calls、report card 式成就）
avoid_traits: 黑客电影式炫酷（mainframe/hack the planet）
可操作的技术教程细节

forbidden_style.rule: 技术机制保持抽象，禁止可操作教程
家人与受害者段落绝对不用幽默
堕落只记录动作与判词，禁止写成快感指南
禁止AI腔套话与空洞升华
禁止把灰色结局浪漫化为自由或成功

transfer_guardrails: 模仿语气、句法和节奏，不复制专有措辞、事实或比喻
